title: X12 278-like request to a Da Vinci PAS-shaped FHIR Bundle
area: Health data standards: X12, FHIR R4, Da Vinci PAS
scenario: Kestrel's new PA engine speaks FHIR (a PAS Bundle around a Claim with use preauthorization) while most requests still arrive as X12 278 from a clearinghouse. Write the adapter from a simplified 278-like format to the Bundle, with resolvable urn:uuid references, ICD-10-CM codes, dates, priority, and a list of what does not map cleanly.
task: Parse the interchange with separators taken from ISA
Map to Claim, Patient, Coverage, Organization, Practitioner, ServiceRequest and Conditions
Raise typed errors for missing segments and bad dates
Write the 'does not map cleanly' list in ANSWER.md
acceptance: Both good fixtures pass the structural checker with no problems
Codes, dates, priority, systems and diagnosis order are correct; ids deterministic
Bad fixtures raise X12Error naming the problem

Week 3 Wed - Da Vinci PAS, CRD, DTR
